channel_visible_c_p1uuid:
((c.kind = 'standard' and c.visibility = 'public')
     or exists (select 1 from channel_member cm_vis
                 where cm_vis.channel_id = c.id and cm_vis.account_id = $1::uuid))
display_body_m:
case when m.kind = 'system' and jsonb_typeof(m.meta->'accountId') = 'string'
            then replace(m.body, '{account}',
                         coalesce((select sa.handle from account sa where sa.id = (CASE WHEN (m.meta->>'accountId') ~ '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$' THEN (m.meta->>'accountId')::uuid END)),
                                  '알 수 없음'))
            else m.body end
channel_visible_ac_p2uuid:
((ac.kind = 'standard' and ac.visibility = 'public')
     or exists (select 1 from channel_member cm_vis
                 where cm_vis.channel_id = ac.id and cm_vis.account_id = $2::uuid))
channel_list_visible_c_aid_aadmin:
((c.kind = 'standard' and a.is_admin)
     or ((c.kind = 'standard' and c.visibility = 'public')
     or exists (select 1 from channel_member cm_vis
                 where cm_vis.channel_id = c.id and cm_vis.account_id = a.id)))
